name: npm-vc-extension
description: In-editor dependency management for package.json: highlights outdated packages, lets you queue upgrades with a code lens, and runs npm install from the editor.

commands.title: npm Version Control: Toggle upgrade mark on package
npm Version Control: Install (and apply queued upgrades)
npm Version Control: Refresh outdated info
npm Version Control: Show output panel

npmVersionControl.registry.description: npm registry base URL used for version lookups.

npmVersionControl.cacheTtlSeconds.description: How long to cache registry lookups, in seconds.

npmVersionControl.npmLogLevel.description: npm --loglevel value used when running install from the extension. `http` and above stream registry activity to the output panel so you can see progress while npm resolves the dependency tree.
